verdict.rationale: Merchants get agent-level allow/deny control via OCA consent ("Find the agent you want to sell through and review its terms", approval requests, and either party can terminate an OCA at any time) plus per-agent order attribution/filtering in the Dashboard, but there is no documented rate-limiting mechanism for specific agents or platforms. missing for 10: explicit per-agent or per-platform rate-limit/throttling controls, granular allow/deny at the platform (vs individual agent) level, and any dashboard UI for setting quotas.
